title: Open direct-image constructibility on arbitrary curves
statement:
Let $T$ be of finite type of dimension at most one over
a finite field or its algebraic closure, let
$j:U\hookrightarrow T$ be open, and let $A$ be finite
and killed by a power of a prime invertible on $T$.
For a constructible
etale $A$-module sheaf $F$, every
$R^qj_*F$ is
constructible on $T$.

proof.text: First handle the empty scheme T: the empty covering axiom makes every etale module sheaf on T zero, hence constructible. Otherwise choose n from the coefficient hypothesis. The positive integer N = ell^n annihilates A, since N times 1 equals zero, and is a unit on T, since ell is a unit. If its image in k were zero, its image in the nonzero local ring at any point of T would be both zero and a unit, a contradiction. Thus N is nonzero in k and is invertible on Spec k. In Lean this uses the proved HasInvertibleExponent.of_hom_of_nonempty, with no hypothesis on the characteristic or dimension beyond those already given.

Place the constructible sheaf F in degree zero. Its only nonzero cohomology is F itself, so it is bounded constructible. Use lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison to pass between finite constant values and the source library IsConstructibleSheaf predicate. The source library boundedConstructible_singleFunctor_obj supplies the standard t-structure bounds a,b; the interval [min a b,max a b] yields the explicit bounds required by def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes. Apply cor-fin-deligne-open-finite-coefficients over k to the open immersion j and F[0]. Its conclusion gives constructibility of the q-th homology sheaf for every integer q.

source.place: Statement, specialized to the sheaf F in degree zero.

proof.text: The proved natural isomorphism Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility identifies the bounded-below derived direct image, included in the ordinary derived category, with the ordinary derived direct image. The degree-zero single functors and homology functors agree under that inclusion by their definitions. Apply the q-th homology functor to the comparison isomorphism and transport the constructibility found in step 2 through its inverse. This proves exactly the unchanged statement. The hypotheses restricting the field and dimension are not used. This node is not a realized statement or proof step of sk-prop-a1-kummer, so its broader existing open-image input changes no realized unit route.
